## Summary

```text
local SWF → repeatable import → numeric Credits layouts / timelines
                              → retained CreditsMotion
historical destinations       → replaceable offline adapter
```

Prepare authored Credits independently of its screen integration: import seven timelines, five shape bounds and nine text layouts; preserve the nonlinear fade, frame34 stop and Back's independent states. Builds on merged #33. Screen painting and caller wiring follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no reusable Credits model/layout metadata or historical-link adapter.
  **After:** source-backed tests cover fade samples, stop34 after200 extra frames, retained Back label, off/on states, attribution/line breaks, control facts and exact historical destinations. The offline adapter reports ServiceUnavailable.
- Two imports are byte-identical and match the backlog data (SHA256 a380c25adbf32261fa6d8c3fcdcd20931e2db96e66bdfd4d2590248892784fa9). All41 display-list frames match the runtime extractor/shared parser; raw labels confirm Back off1/on2 and raw font bits corroborate styles.
- Formatting, TypeScript,454 rule/parser tests /5777 assertions and production build pass. This slice changes no visible browser flow. FontInfo only declares numeric flags the parser already emits.
- Imported data contains decoded copy and numerical facts, with no artwork, font contours, SWF or media. Credits.as/pcode, Back scripts, menu handlers and exported text independently support the modeled contracts.
- Source also sends rollover labels to transparent one-frame Hero/Composer targets; this model changes only Back's visible pose. Identical handler/error execution, source action-guard caller, native/mock screen painting, global phase and original-runtime pixels remain unverified. Historical URLs are inactive metadata, with no current availability/ownership claim. Complete Credits/menu/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** metadata

Adds an unused model/import and isolated adapter. The existing Credits screen remains until its separate integration PR.
